nodes.label: fn_config_value
nodes.rationale: Card ^ref-11 / R12, ADR-006, ADR-018: one dated lookup for thirty config keys, returning the whole config_settings row so text and jsonb keys use the same resolution as numeric ones and adding a key stays a data change. CONFIG_NOT_SET is a RAISE, not a null — a null invites coalesce(..., 0) at a call site and a zero rate produces a settled-looking figure, the exact failure ADR-006/BR23/BR04 exist to prevent. p_event_date has no default, because now() would resolve a closed period against today's rate. SCOPE BEATS RECENCY: a branch-scoped row wins over a global row even when the global row is newer, so an Owner editing a global default cannot silently override a deliberate per-branch value. EXECUTE granted to NOBODY (config_settings holds prices; R20 keeps L3 out), and since ^ref-64 the grant is no longer the only enforcement — the body raises NO_ACTOR when auth.uid() is null, because ADR-004's "RLS decides" does not reach inside a SECURITY DEFINER function.

nodes.label: fn_config_numeric
nodes.rationale: Thin typed wrapper over fn_config_value for the column almost every call site wants. Raises CONFIG_WRONG_TYPE when a text or jsonb key is asked for as a number, because a null rate is the same failure CONFIG_NOT_SET exists to stop, one step further downstream. NO_ACTOR is inherited, not repeated — the fn_config_value call is the first statement of the body, so one guard in one place. EXECUTE granted to nobody: a primitive for definer functions, not a read path.

hyperedges.label: Dated config resolution stack (one lookup, typed readers, never a default)
